title: RMSProp Optimizer Step
signature: def rmsprop_step(param, grad, square_avg, lr=0.01, alpha=0.99, eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0.0) -> tuple
hints: square_avg is an exponential moving average of g^2. alpha is the weight on the OLD average.
Update square_avg first, then divide the gradient by sqrt(square_avg) + eps.
There is no bias correction in RMSProp, and eps goes outside the square root.
